findings.summary: own_orphans cleanup exceptions can bypass subreaper restoration
findings.evidence: A mock reproducer injected OSError from waitpid after prior subreaper state 0; PR_SET_CHILD_SUBREAPER was called with [1] only and never restored to 0.
findings.required_fix: Restore the prior subreaper state from a separate finally path even when proc_fields, kill, or waitpid cleanup raises, and add regression coverage.

scope_notes: Escaped daemon identity is grounded by an explicit external fixture oracle and does not claim arbitrary daemon discovery.
User confirmation does not clear a live unknown; a fresh recheck after owned cleanup is required.
Cleanup targets only fixture-owned PID/start-time identities.
Mutation controls and the existing env/launch matrix were materially discriminating.
